issues.issue: The 555 loss on disposal is printed among the nonoperating items, and it went into other_financing combined with the capital contributions. That is defensible as an asset-disposal item, but it could also be a nonoperating expense line. The arithmetic is correct.
The rules define accrued liabilities as compensated absences due soon. This is the noncurrent portion, so 'other liabilities' may fit better.
